verdict.rationale: Meltano's CLI-first workflow (meltano init, meltano add, meltano config test, meltano run) and its environments concept (dev/qa/prod) support local development and testing of pipelines before promoting to production, as documented and echoed by a community user describing dev/qa/prod environments in a single repo. However, the evidence never explicitly discusses using a 'lightweight' destination (e.g., DuckDB, jsonl, SQLite) for local testing, nor a documented local-to-prod promotion workflow. Missing for 10: explicit lightweight/local destination guidance, documented dev-to-prod promotion workflow, hands-on confirmation of local pipeline testing against a lightweight target.
